audience: bookkeepers and small firms that keep their books in e-conomic and want answers from an assistant

useCases.title: Find customers with overdue invoices
useCases.text: List the overdue invoices and the total they owe. Open a customer to read its contacts and payment terms before you call them.

useCases.title: Draft an invoice for a customer
useCases.text: Find the customer and the product numbers, then create a draft invoice with its lines. A person books and sends the draft in e-conomic.

useCases.title: Review the booked invoices of a period
useCases.text: List the booked invoices of a month or a year, then open one to read its lines, VAT and due date.

useCases.title: Check the balance of a ledger account
useCases.text: Read the accounting years, then look up an account in the chart of accounts to see its balance.

useCases.title: Create a customer with the right terms
useCases.text: Read the customer group, VAT zone and payment term numbers. Then create the customer with its name and these settings.

useCases.title: Add a product or service with a sales price
useCases.text: Read the product group and unit numbers, then create a product with a unique number, a name and a sales price.
